meta.title: Creator showcase — viral4creators
meta.description: A catalog of creators and agencies, UGC video portfolios, and a no-tender product brief — Stage 0 of the viral4creators marketplace.

login.loginFailed: Telegram login failed — please try again.

catalog.title: Find a creator for your UGC video
catalog.hintPrefix: Real work portfolios, no tender or upfront payment on the platform — reach out to a creator directly. Can't find a fit?
catalog.hintLink: Describe your task — we'll suggest matches
catalog.emptyState: No one is currently accepting orders for this filter — try clearing the filters or check back later.

crossPost.hint: X posts in one click. Instagram and TikTok have no public web intent for a ready-made post — the caption is copied, you attach the video yourself on their side.

qr.alt: QR code linking to the profile

brief.heading: Describe your task
brief.hint: No tender and no upfront payment: we'll match you with fitting creators from the catalog, and you connect and agree on terms directly.
brief.brandAttached: Brand book attached — the creator will see your brand style along with the product description.
brief.productPlaceholder: E.g.: handmade hand cream, we want a viral unboxing video…
brief.isLineLabel: This is a product line, not a single item
brief.budgetPlaceholder: For matching by price only — this isn't a payment
brief.errorTooShort: Please describe the product in more detail (at least a couple of sentences).
brief.errorSubmit: Couldn't create the brief — log in with Telegram (button in the header) and try again.

formatAdvice.instagram_reels: Vertical 9:16, fast quality is enough for Reels.
formatAdvice.tiktok: Vertical 9:16, fast quality is enough for TikTok.
formatAdvice.youtube_shorts: Vertical 9:16, fast quality is enough for Shorts.
formatAdvice.youtube_long: Horizontal 16:9 and standard quality — pre-rolls get watched longer than shorts.
formatAdvice.other: Platform not recognized — 16:9 as a safe default; check with the creator before filming.
